system.description:
Everything has a price. He knows it. He always collects.

  • Dark Gift (1st): For 1 Patron Favour, appraise the exact value of any object or learn the price a creature would pay for any secret, service, or soul.
  • A creature whose wealth or worth you appraise this way suffers disadvantage on its next save or Charisma-based check against you.
  • You may use it as part of your action in combat.
  • Patron's Mark (4th): Passive: you always know the exact monetary value of anything you look at, and can sense whether a creature is carrying more wealth than they appear to have.
  • Patron Feature (8th): For 1 Patron Favour, offer a Mammon's Bargain (Will save against your Class Save DC, to refuse). A creature that accepts and breaks it loses 2d6 HP per day until honoured or dead.

Allegiance: Lawful Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Mammon in the World of Arneyan wiki.
